cases.name: attributed_curve_sweep_from_faces_disc
cases.note: #1462 P6: curve_sweep_from_faces_disc with every disc face and edge tagged by its own SM_AB_COPY long attribute first. Upstream copies only the edge curves (SmPrimitiveCreation::CreateCurveSweepFromFaces / FromEdges), so the result carries none and the borrowed discs keep theirs.
